# The box as face loops. The top loop's last vertex is at z = 2.5, 0.5 out of its
# plane. Invalid: NonPlanarFace (and ConcaveInput, the vertex pokes out of the solid).
loop -1 -1.5 -2 1 -1.5 -2 1 1.5 -2 -1 1.5 -2
loop -1 -1.5 2 1 -1.5 2 1 1.5 2 -1 1.5 2.5
loop -1 -1.5 -2 -1 1.5 -2 -1 1.5 2 -1 -1.5 2
loop 1 -1.5 -2 1 1.5 -2 1 1.5 2 1 -1.5 2
loop -1 -1.5 -2 1 -1.5 -2 1 -1.5 2 -1 -1.5 2
loop -1 1.5 -2 1 1.5 -2 1 1.5 2 -1 1.5 2
